main_text.head: XII. Reliquarum permutationes rationes sunt, occurrit enim
main_text.p: XIII. Quod ad 2. & 3. modum attinet, eandem literæ אהוי longè sæpius redundant & deficiunt quam aliæ...
א enim medio vocis redundat 45. locis, ut ינאין[?]/
Ex reliquis redundant tantùm לש semel, כפת bis, ג ter, ב quater, ער quinquies.
XIV. Deficiunt quoque literæ הוי in principio, medio & fine, satis frequenter, Et quidem.

page.notes: The Hebrew letters and the small numerals after them are taken from a small, faint scan; several letters, especially the first entries of the braces and the final partial group at the bottom, are doubtful and may need checking. The label before the last group is illegible at its start. Entries with [?] were not confirmed. Hebrew words are printed in the scan at a small size and are only partly legible; the doubtful ones are marked [?]. The fragment at the top right, a brace with "ה" and "2.", is cut off and not transcribed as text. The page number "44" is printed at the lower right with a Hebrew letter ה before it. The Google digitiser watermark at the lower right is left out.
